posts.text:
Parents shouldn’t have to pay thousands of dollars just so their kids can play sports. 

Youth sports change lives. It shouldn’t be a luxury only for the wealthy.

That’s why I’m fighting for the Let Kids Play Act — to push back against private equity greed and bring costs down for every family.

Video

Trump doesn’t care about cutting costs for American families — not skyrocketing groceries, not crushing gas prices. His biggest concern is building himself a ballroom.

Video

More and more people in the MAHA movement are feeling betrayed—and they're calling out the Trump administration’s broken promises on cleaner air, safer food that’s free of toxic chemicals, and healthier lives for our kids and families.

Video

I want to share with you some deeply powerful advice from a woman whose life and words have inspired millions — Oprah Winfrey.

Video

Martyrs for our democracy overcame our past.

We can overcome the terrible Supreme Court decision now if we take this election seriously.

Video

Trump is putting brave Americans in harms way with his dangerous and failed war with Iran, while at home comfortable Congress people are not doing their job to defend the constitution.

It is unacceptable.

Video

How do we know Trump’s presidency is a sinking ship?

It’s because of the experience of the American people: prices are up and he’s gotten us in another disaster in the Middle East.

Video

That's the spirit of our families—mothers who show up, lift us up, and fuel dreams both on and off the field.

Video

The power of the people is always greater than the people in power.

Looking forward to standing with the people of Alabama this weekend.

The costs of the Iran war are hitting every American, at the grocery store and at the pump.

Sports transformed my life — and I’ve seen how they transform countless young people. We must make youth sports accessible & affordable for EVERY American child. Skyrocketing costs driven by corporate greed are keeping kids on the bench.

Video

Donald Trump will sell out America to serve himself.

He’ll sell out our workers, our democracy, and our national interests for personal gain. This the same pattern of corruption we’ve seen time and again from him and his family.

Congress must do its job, hold him accountable, and stop  this endless grift.

Video

It's a long journey... Don't Stop...

Video

Every time I turn around this President is finding a new way to grift off the American people.

Video

Everyone knows Congressman Clyburn is a leader who has stood up not just for his district, but for his entire state - and the ridiculous criticism of him  sounds  like coded bigotry to me.

Video

Incredible wisdom from an incredible woman.

Video

Instead of fighting to save hardworking American families money — here’s what Donald Trump is focused on: putting himself on money.

He’s not thinking about your wallet. He’s thinking about what else he can stick his  name on.

An update on my fight to make youth sports more affordable: Spring sports are underway, but too many kids are stuck on the sidelines—not because they lack talent or desire, but because their families simply can’t afford it.
